title: Stay Flawless All Day: Wedding Touch-Up Secrets From Luxury Artists
excerpt: Keep your bridal look picture-perfect from ceremony to reception with these expert touch-up tips from Velora Bella.
content: Your wedding day is a marathon, and your makeup should go the distance with you. Pack a small touch-up kit with blotting papers, your lip color, and a travel-size setting spray to refresh your glow between moments. A quick press—never rub—keeps your foundation seamless while translucent powder tames shine without disturbing your flawless finish.

title: Soft Glam vs Full Glam: Which Bridal Look Was Made for You?
excerpt: Discover whether soft glam or full glam is your ideal bridal makeup style for a flawless, unforgettable wedding day look.
content: Soft glam embraces luminous skin, subtle definition, and romantic neutrals that photograph beautifully in natural light — perfect for garden or beach weddings. Full glam, on the other hand, delivers bold lashes, sculpted contour, and rich pigment that commands attention in grand ballrooms and candlelit venues. At Velora Bella, our luxury artists tailor every look to your vision, ensuring your makeup feels as extraordinary as the moment itself.
